data.name: Yaminiya
data.gender_notes: Yaminiya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Yama, the God of death and the daughter of the night. The name Yaminiya carries the meaning “Night's daughter” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Yaminiya usually hope their child will grow to embody night's daughter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine balance between life and death.
data.etymology: Yaminiya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night's daughter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yaminiya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_sanskrit.name: यमिनीया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Yaminiya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Yamini' which means night. It is often associated with the coolness and serenity of the night.

in_hindi.name: यमिनीया
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम यमिनीया हिंदी में रात्रि का अर्थ है। यह संस्कृत शब्द 'यमिनि' से प्राप्त है जो रात्रि का अर्थ है। यमिनीया नाम रात्रि की शान्ति और स्थिरता से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_tamil.name: யமினீயா
in_tamil.long_meaning: தமிழில் யமினீயா ஞாயிறு அர்த்தம் அடையும். இந்த பெயர் ஸங்கீதத்தில் 'யமினி' என்ற தமிழ் வார்த்தையில் உருவாக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது, அது ஞாயிறு அர்த்தம் கொண்டது.

in_telugu.name: యమినీయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: తెలుగులో యమినీయ రాత్రి அర్ஹத్ అందుబాటులో ఉందు. ఈ పేరు సంస్కృతం శబ్దం 'యమిని' సేవే ఉందు, అది రాత్రి అర్థం కొడుతుందు.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Yaminiya" holds a significant cultural impact as it is derived from the name of the God of death, Yama. In Hindu traditions, Yama is considered as the king of the netherworld and is responsible for the process of death and rebirth. The suffix '-iya' in the name indicates a connection or association with Yama. This name is often associated with the spiritual journey of life and death.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Yaminiya" lies in its connection to Yama, who is a central figure in Hinduism and represents the concept of death and rebirth. The name signifies the understanding that life is not constant but is part of a cycle, where death leads to new birth. It serves as a reminder to live a meaningful and virtuous life, following the dharma or righteous path, to ensure a good rebirth in the next life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Yaminiya: Goddess of righteousness and virtue. Embodiment of ethical principles and moral values. She is the one who guides and protects the virtuous on their spiritual journey.

historical_references.context: Yaminiya is a form of the goddess Yami, who is the sister of Yama, the god of death.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Yaminiya continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
